label: Engineering Implementation
description: Land it, in an order that keeps the tree green at every step, with the unit tests that defend phase-4 invariants written here beside the code they check (feature.md §5). Four separate rules, each about one child — the confirm skip on explore, the abort on confirm, the implementation/design split on classify, the refine loop on critique — so each is eligible only in the round its own child ended.

inputs.returned_findings.description: What a LATER phase found wrong with this one, which is why control came back here. Absent on the way down. Shapes differ by sender — a review finding carries `severity`/`claim`/`lens`, a design finding raised by acceptance or implementation carries whatever that phase recorded — so read each entry for what it says rather than expecting one shape.
